annotations.title: Watch a post for N days

description: TRACKING WINDOWS: watch a post's views and engagement once a day for N days (1-90, default 30), then take a final reading and send the post.tracking_completed event (webhooks, Slack, Discord). action open (postId of a post the brand published: read through the brand's own connection, free; or url of ANY public TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X or Threads post: one data lookup per reading, quoted in full and confirm-gated — call without confirm to see the quote, then confirm:true once the user agrees), get, list (status open / completed / cancelled) or cancel (no final reading, no event, no further charges). X posts the brand published are tracked through their public link, since X bills every API read. Each reading lands on the post's timeline (post_metrics_timeline).

action.description: open a window, read one, list them, or cancel one

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only

confirm.description: open on a link: true once the user accepted the quote

postId.description: open: a post the brand published (record id, platform id or link)

url.description: open: a link to any public post
